lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu jan bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad man asathir hovai anadin har ras rahiaa aghaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the mind becomes steady and stable; night and day, it remains satisfied with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin bhagat karahu din raatee is jug kaa laahaa bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Night and day, perform devotional worship service to the Lord, day and night; this is the profit to be obtained in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa jan niramal mail na laagai sach naam chit laaee ||2||
lines.translation: The humble beings are forever immaculate; no filth ever sticks to them. They focus their consciousness on the True Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh seegaar satiguroo dikhaaiaa naam vadee vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has revealed the ornamentation of peace; the Glorious Greatness of the Naam is Great!

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਭਰੇ ਕਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: akhut bha(n)daar bhare kade tot na aavai sadaa har sevahu bhaaee ||3||
lines.translation: The Inexhaustible Treasures are overflowing; they are never exhausted. So serve the Lord forever, O Siblings of Destiny. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape karataa jis no devai tis vasai man aaee ||
lines.translation: The Creator comes to abide in the minds of those whom He Himself has blessed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam dhiaai sadaa too satigur deeaa dikhaaee ||4||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meditate forever on the Naam, which the True Guru has revealed. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪੇ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: niraguneeaare kau bakhas lai suaamee aape laihu milaaee ||
lines.translation: I am unworthy; please forgive me and bless me, O my Lord and Master, and unite me with Yourself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: too bia(n)t teraa a(n)t na paaiaa sabade dehu bujhaaee ||1||
lines.translation: You are Endless; no one can find Your limits. Through the Word of Your Shabad, You bestow understanding. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu tudh vitahu bal jaaee ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, I am a sacrifice to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਾਂ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man arapee tudh aagai raakhau sadaa rahaa(n) saranaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I dedicate my mind and body and place them in offering before You; I shall remain in Your Sanctuary forever. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapane bhaane vich sadaa rakh suaamee har naamo dehi vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: Please keep me forever under Your Will, O my Lord and Master; please bless me with the Glorious Greatness of Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਭਾਣਾ ਜਾਪੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: poore gur te bhaanaa jaapai anadin sahaj samaaee ||2||
lines.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, God's Will is revealed; night and day, remain absorbed in peace and poise. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: terai bhaanai bhagat je tudh bhaavai aape bakhas milaaee ||
lines.translation: Those devotees who accept Your Will are pleasing to You, Lord; You Yourself forgive them, and unite them with Yourself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: terai bhaanai sadaa sukh paaiaa gur trisanaa agan bujhaaee ||3||
lines.translation: Accepting Your Will, I have found everlasting peace; the Guru has extinguished the fire of desire. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo too karahi s hovai karate avar na karanaa jaaee ||
lines.translation: Whatever You do comes to pass, O Creator; nothing else can be done.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naavai jevad avar na daataa poore gur te paaee ||4||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, nothing is as great as the Blessing of the Name; it is obtained through the Perfect Guru. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਤਿਨ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh har saalaahiaa ji(n)naa tin salaahi har jaataa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs praise the Lord; praising the Lord, they know Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: vichahu bharam gaiaa hai doojaa gur kai sabad pachhaataa ||1||
lines.translation: Doubt and duality are gone from within; they realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu too meraa ik soee ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, You are my One and Only.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜਪੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh japee tudhai saalaahee gat mat tujh te hoee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I meditate on You and praise You; salvation and wisdom come from You. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh saalaahan se saad paain meethaa a(n)mrit saar ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs praise You; they receive the most excellent and sweet Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਮੀਠਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਫੀਕਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa meethaa kade na pheekaa gurasabadee veechaar ||2||
lines.translation: This Nectar is forever sweet; it never loses its taste. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin meethaa laaiaa soee jaanai tis vitahu bal jaaee ||
lines.translation: He makes it seem so sweet to me; I am a sacrifice to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabad salaahee sadaa sukhadaataa vichahu aap gavaaee ||3||
lines.translation: Through the Shabad, I praise the Giver of peace forever. I have eradicated self-conceit from within. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur meraa sadaa hai daataa jo ichhai so phal paae ||
lines.translation: My True Guru is forever the Giver. I receive whatever fruits and rewards I desire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee gurasabadee sach paae ||4||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, glorious greatness is obtained; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the True One is found. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo teree saranaaee har jeeu tin too raakhan jog ||
lines.translation: Those who enter Your Sanctuary, Dear Lord, are saved by Your Protective Power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tudh jevad mai avar na soojhai naa ko hoaa na hog ||1||
lines.translation: I cannot even conceive of any other as Great as You. There never was, and there never shall be. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu sadaa teree saranaaee ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, I shall remain in Your Sanctuary forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਏਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu raakhahu mere suaamee eh teree vadiaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: As it pleases You, You save me, O my Lord and Master; this is Your Glorious Greatness. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo teree saranaaee har jeeu tin kee karahi pratipaal ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, You cherish and sustain those who seek Your Sanctuary.
